collocations.urdu: چیف ایگزیکٹو افسر؛ ادارے کا اعلیٰ انتظامی سربراہ
collocations.example: The CEO announced the new hiring plan.

collocations.meaning: Curriculum vitae; a document describing education, experience and qualifications.
collocations.urdu: تعلیم، تجربے اور قابلیت کی تفصیل پر مشتمل دستاویز
collocations.example: Please attach your CV to the application.

collocations.meaning: Deoxyribonucleic acid; a molecule that carries genetic information.
collocations.example: The laboratory compared DNA from the two samples.

collocations.meaning: Gross domestic product; the total value of final goods and services produced within an economy over a specified period.
collocations.urdu: ایک معیشت میں مقررہ مدت کے دوران تیار حتمی اشیا اور خدمات کی مجموعی قدر
collocations.example: The report compares GDP across three countries.

collocations.meaning: Central processing unit; the part of a computer that executes program instructions.
collocations.urdu: کمپیوٹر کا مرکزی حصہ جو پروگرام کی ہدایات پر عمل کرتا ہے
collocations.example: This program places a heavy load on the CPU.

collocations.meaning: Uniform resource locator; an address identifying the location of a resource on a network.
collocations.urdu: نیٹ ورک پر کسی وسیلے کا پتہ
collocations.example: Paste the URL into the address bar.

collocations.meaning: Artificial intelligence; computer systems or methods for tasks involving abilities associated with intelligence.
collocations.example: The course discusses the limitations of AI.

collocations.meaning: Hypertext Markup Language; the markup language used to structure web documents.
collocations.urdu: ویب دستاویزات کی ساخت بنانے کی مارک اپ زبان
collocations.example: We used HTML to structure the page.

collocations.meaning: Portable Document Format; a file format designed to preserve document presentation.
collocations.urdu: دستاویز کی پیش کش برقرار رکھنے والا فائل فارمیٹ
collocations.example: Send the completed form as a PDF.

collocations.meaning: For your information; used to introduce information someone may find useful.
collocations.example: FYI, the meeting starts at ten tomorrow.

collocations.meaning: Repeated practice can help a person improve a skill.
collocations.urdu: بار بار مشق سے مہارت بہتر ہوتی ہے
collocations.example: When I struggled with the tune, my teacher said practice makes perfect.

collocations.meaning: What someone does is stronger evidence of their intentions than what they say.
collocations.urdu: عمل باتوں سے زیادہ مؤثر گواہی دیتا ہے
collocations.example: She promised to help, but actions speak louder than words.

collocations.phrase: where there is a will, there is a way
collocations.meaning: Determination can help someone find a solution to a difficult task.
collocations.urdu: پختہ ارادہ ہو تو راستہ نکل آتا ہے
collocations.example: We kept trying because where there is a will there is a way.

collocations.meaning: Used to introduce a fact, often correcting or adding to what was said.
collocations.example: As a matter of fact, I have already read the report.

collocations.meaning: For now, until circumstances change.
collocations.urdu: فی الحال؛ موجودہ وقت کے لیے
collocations.example: For the time being, we will use the smaller room.

collocations.phrase: on the one hand ... on the other hand
collocations.meaning: Used to introduce a contrasting consideration.
collocations.urdu: دوسری طرف؛ اس کے برعکس پہلو
collocations.example: The flat is small; on the other hand, it is close to work.

collocations.meaning: Direct your concentration towards someone or something.
collocations.example: Please pay attention to the instructions.

collocations.meaning: Accept a duty or acknowledge accountability for something.
collocations.example: I will take responsibility for checking the figures.

collocations.meaning: Rain falling in large amounts.
collocations.example: Heavy rain delayed the match.

collocations.meaning: Evidence that gives substantial support to a claim.
collocations.example: The study provides strong evidence for the claim.
